ftf.name: ftf
ftf.description: Tell someone how to get their FTF (First To Find) noticed on Project-GC.

responses.ftfInfo: here are two ways for Project-GC to detect your FTFs (**F**irst **T**o **F**inds). Either you tag your logs with one of these tags: `{*FTF*}`, `{FTF}`, or `[FTF]`. Alternatively you can add an FTF bookmark list under Settings (<https://project-gc.com/User/Settings/>) that will be checked once per day. Please understand that FTF isn't anything offical and not everyone tags their FTFs. Therefore this list won't be 100% accurate.

logo.name: logo
logo.description: Give someone information about the logo kits for Geocaching.

responses.errTell: Error telling {{author.ping}} about the [Logo Kits](<https://www.geocaching.com/about/logousage.aspx>) via `/logo` request.
responses.logoInfo:
you seem to be looking for the Official Geocaching.com [Logo Kits](<https://www.geocaching.com/about/logousage.aspx>).
The kits have `*.png` & `*.eps` file versions.  If you're looking for an `*.svg` version, the Staff on the [Geocaching Discord](<https://discord.gg/invite/WQt4f7p>) recommends using [EPS to SVG Converter](<https://cloudconvert.com/eps-to-svg>) by cloud**convert**
